note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Returned unopposed. Printed "Glassdrummand". John Jeffers: no party label printed in 1936. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Forkhill, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1933, printed 'N': Lurgan Mail, 29 April 1933, p. 3 ("County and Rural Council Elections"); Forkhill, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1936, printed 'N': Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1936, p. 4 ("Local Government Nominations: Armagh County Council"); Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1936, p. 6 ("The Elections"); Forkhill, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1939, printed 'N': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections")).
